program.name: Boxing EMOM
program.subject: Boxing
program.blurb: Shadowboxing bouts, then an EMOM of punches, push-ups and core for a fighter's fitness.
program.about: Shadowboxing for skill, then an EMOM for a fighter's fitness. Three or four bouts of combinations come first, called out by the voice. Then every minute starts a short set of punches, push-ups, burpees or core, resting in what is left. Abs finish every session. Levels II and III bring longer combinations and harder moves in the EMOM.
